name: ECommerce '99
summary:
eCommerce ‘99 is the business simulator that lets you go from zero to CEO. Set just before the burst of the dotcom bubble you start out to create a business empire. A small severance, a garage and your cat Jeff are all you have to get you going but soon you will oversee multiple warehouses and offices filled with your employees.

eCommerce ‘99 takes the simulation genre that has become popular in the last two years to the next level. It lets the player interact with a customer and price simulation not seen in the genre. Using tools like price setting, marketing and their eCommerce website Players can create monopolies or crash the market for each product.

For players more interested in creativity than management the game comes with a plethora of different furniture and cosmetic items that allow for a high level of customization. Not only can you optimize your fulfillment routines but make them pretty too.
